mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and can cause severe renal impairment; foscarnet may increase ganciclovir levels by competing for renal clearance and both inhibit creatinine secretion.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, monitor renal function closely (creatinine, BUN), maintain adequate hydration, consider dose adjustments based on creatinine clearance, and monitor for nephrotoxicity signs.
